item.title: Texas softball goes 5-0 in Bevo Classic, gears up for big West Coast tournament
item.description: The Longhorns topped the Huskies 9-1 and beat the Buckeyes 7-4, moving to 9-1 on the season.

item.title: Ukulele band serenades runners during Austin Marathon
item.description: While the Austin Marathon draws in people from all over the nation, it also draws people in Austin out of their homes.

item.title: Two East Texas officers shot during violent warrant operation
item.description: Two East Texas officers were shot and a suspect was killed in a violent warrant operation in Wood County, TX, after the suspect allegedly opened fire with a semi-automatic weapon.

item.title: Volantis twirls gem in season debut, Texas sweeps UC Davis
item.description: Volantis mowed through the UC Davis lineup, allowing one hit with eight strikeouts in seven innings in a 9-1 Texas win to sweep the Aggies on UFCU Disch-Falk Field. An unearned run crossed the plate in the sixth inning, but he needed just 78 pitches to get through his outing before Michael Winter worked the final two frames.

item.title: Investigation launched into firetruck manufacturers for allegedly driving up prices
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has opened an investigation into firetruck manufacturers over alleged anticompetitive practices that his office says have caused “dramatic price increases” for firefighting equipment and threaten public safety, according to a news release.

item.title: What statewide races are on your ballot? A look ahead to the Texas primaries
item.description: Early voting in the Texas 2026 primaries starts next Tuesday, with voters able to choose a Republican or Democratic ballot and vote in high-profile races including for U.S. Senate, Attorney General, Agriculture Commissioner and Comptroller of Public Accounts.

item.title: Warming temperatures this week, low rain chances
item.description: President's Day will be mostly sunny with high temperatures in the 70s. Our normal high is 67°. -- Meteorologist Tommy House

item.title: 1 dead, 1 hurt in north Austin overnight shooting
item.description: One person is dead and another person was hurt after a deadly shooting in north Austin Sunday overnight.

item.title: 'Risks to children.' Why Texas is warning about unregulated home child care
item.description: Finding child care in Texas can be tough because of prices and waitlists. Some parents choose child care homes instead of centers, often due to limited options. But KXAN Investigators learned the state found hundreds of those home providers operating without a license or any oversight.

item.title: Who won the 2026 Austin Marathon? Full results of 5K, half-marathon, marathon
